title: Bihar BSEB DELED Spot Admission 2025-27
vacancyDetails: Spot / leftover seat admission in D.El.Ed training institutes for session 2025-27
qualification: As per BSEB D.El.Ed eligibility (Intermediate + entrance/merit norms)
applicationFee: Institute fee as per BSEB / college notice
selectionProcess: Merit / previous counselling → Spot admission against vacant seats at institutes
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, photo ID, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bsebdeled.com or BSEB D.El.Ed portal
2. Check spot admission / vacant seat notice
3. Download institute-wise vacancy list
4. Report to concerned D.El.Ed institute with documents
5. Complete fee and admission formalities on the spot
shortDescription: Bihar BSEB D.El.Ed Spot Admission 2025-27 – report to institutes for leftover seats as per BSEB notice on bsebdeled.com.
content:
Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) conducts admissions to Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.) training institutes.

After regular counselling rounds, spot admission is held for vacant seats of session 2025–27. Candidates should check institute-wise vacancy lists on the official D.El.Ed portal and report with original documents within the notified dates.
